name: Approved reference structure is the first visible experience
description: Verifies the first visible TECHPLOYX screen follows the approved reference structure instead of presenting a different hero composition.
steps: Open the English landing
Confirm the first screen has a white/light-blue background
Confirm the large left headline and blue Into Customers line are prominent
Confirm a large laptop dashboard and phone assistant dominate the right side
Confirm four benefit items run along the bottom
Confirm EN / ES and both hero buttons are visible
Confirm there is no multi-item navigation menu
expected: The first visible screen matches the approved reference structure while keeping the latest simplified navigation decisions.

name: Spanish reference structure remains usable on mobile
description: Verifies the same reference-based structure remains readable and functional in Spanish on mobile.
steps: Open the Spanish landing on mobile
Confirm Spanish content appears immediately
Confirm EN / ES is visible
Confirm both hero actions are visible
Confirm laptop and phone remain recognizable
expected: The mobile version preserves the approved visual hierarchy and chat-led actions.

name: Qualified visitor is captured inside chat
description: Verifies the visual rebuild does not break in-chat lead capture.
steps: Open Talk to TECHPLOYX
Describe a real business problem
Show intent to get help
Provide your name when asked
Provide one contact method when asked
expected: The agent keeps the visitor in chat and captures the qualified lead for follow-up.

name: What We Do remains in the same page experience
description: Verifies the secondary button keeps the visitor on the same page and opens a services-oriented conversation.
steps: Open the landing
Click What We Do
expected: The chat opens and the visitor is not navigated to a different page.

name: Command Center supports Passkey sign-in
description: Verifies the Command Center offers device-based Passkey sign-in and preserves protected operational data access.
steps: Open admin.html
Confirm the Sign in with Passkey button is visible
Complete the device passkey prompt for a previously registered user
Review Leads and Sales / Prospects
expected: The admin can open the protected Command Center with the TECHPLOYX username and access PIN, without email, Google, or QR.
